scene yumiisheretoowtf1
: Come on, come on, come on! Pick up, you stupid fucking whore!
scene yumiisheretoowtf2
: Yumi? Hey. What’s up? I thought you were trying to stay out of-
scene yumiisheretoowtf3
: Yeah, cool! Whatever! What fucking day is it right now?
: What?
: Sorry, but I ain’t got time to fuck around! Or...maybe I do? Either way, just tell me what god damn day it is, Chika!
scene yumiisheretoowtf4
: I mean, I was trying not to bring attention to the fact that it’s your birthday because you always hate it when I do that. But if you really want me to sing for you, I will.
: Okay. So it’s still Halloween. But where the fuck are you?
scene yumiisheretoowtf5
: I’m still at the cafe for the stand-up comedy thing. We were all about to head to the hotel, but some stuff went down and now we’re all kind of just awkwardly waiting around.
: Why, though? You having second thoughts? Want to come hang out after all?
scene yumiisheretoowtf6
: What stand-up comedy thing? The fuck are you talkin’ about?
: For the Dorm Wars. Tsuneyo kind of wiped the floor with Ayane, so we basically all need to win tomorrow if we’re going to come in first.
scene yumiisheretoowtf7
: The Dorm Wars?...
: Yumi, is everything okay? You sound kinda weird.
: What are you dressed as this year?
: I think you called it a...sex dog. But I’m a wolf-girl. That’s what the costume was labeled as at least. Have you seriously already forgotten? What the hell’s going on with you?
: I’ve got no fucking clue...
scene yumiisheretoowtf5
: It’s gonna sound fuckin’ crazy, but like...I think I just jumped like two years into the past.
: Neat. Do Sensei and I ever get together in the future or is he still fucking his niece?
: What? No, I don’t give a shit about that. Just...is Makoto there?
: Makoto? What do you want Makoto for? I thought you hated her?
scene yumiisheretoowtf8
: I don’t hate her. She’s just fuckin’...different from me, okay? But can you make her stick around, please? I need to talk to her about somethin’ before I blow my fuckin’ brains out.
: Why don’t you just meet us at the hotel instead? It’s the same one where we always hang out on holidays. You remember how to get there, right?
: Yeah, I remember...
: And, like...just out of curiosity, shit just...feels totally normal to you?
: I don’t think any of us feel “normal” after what we just witnessed, but I’m not sure what you mean apart from that- which you weren’t even here for.
: So you don’t remember gettin’ into a fight with me over allegedly cozying up to your creeper “boyfriend?”
: I have a boyfriend? Since when?
scene yumiisheretoowtf9
: Where the fuck am I?...

: That’s what I want to know! You’re being super sketchy, so I’ll just call you a taxi and you can meet us at the hotel. Okay? Now, tell me more about this boyfriend you dreamt up. Is he hot? What grade is he in?
scene black
: Don’t worry about it. Just...make sure Four-Eyes knows I’m comin’, okay? And definitely don’t try to get a boyfriend any time soon. You’re a fucking psychotic mess when you have one.
: Why do you have such a weird version of me inside your head?! I’d be a great girlfriend! You just don’t understand because you’re immune to love.
: Yeah, cool. Bye.
: Yumi, wait-
: Is this...how this shit always works?...
scene yumiisheretoowtf10
No!
No, it wasn’t. But of course Yumi didn’t know that because this was her first foray into what it’s really like living in Kumon-mi. And boy what a foray it would be!

Fortunately though, there was no shortage of people in different places experiencing the same thing to share her confusion with! Unfortunately, however, most of them happened to be in different places in time.
scene yumiisheretoowtf11
Like these two! Or at least one of these two! Kind of.
Maya Makinami knew that something was wrong-ish, but she couldn’t put her finger on what as the lingering memory of a fight from earlier this morning overwrote everything else she was feeling.
Or almost everything at least! Because these are really just guesses and I can’t actually peer into her head! But if I could, I imagine she’d be thinking of Ami as well.
Probably something like, “Wow, her legs are soft.” Or, “Wow! She smells so nice!” Or, “Wow, I hope she tears off my costume and throws me onto the floor and finger-fucks me until I piss myself!”
You know. Normal things that normal people think. And Maya Makinami is a NORMAL TEENAGE GIRL after all.
And what better time to experiment than when you’re alone and curious and horny and sad and traveling through time?!
NOW KISS.
: So...Maya. Is there anything you need? Anything I can get you? A drink? Maybe a nice scalp massage or something?
: No, I’m fine...I think I just need to rest a little. It was kind of loud in there and...I’m feeling kind of disoriented. Like I’m not supposed to be here.
scene yumiisheretoowtf12
: Where else would you be? I’d feel super lonely if you just left me here on my own. You and I are supposed to stick together, remember?
: I don’t mean it like I’m literally considering leaving. I’m just kind of...derealizing, I guess? Do you know what that means?
: No, I’m dumb.
scene yumiisheretoowtf13
: Well, since you’re so dumb, allow me to explain.
: I basically just mean that this feels more like a movie than real life. And that any minute now, I’m going to wake up in our dorm room and hear you moaning Sensei’s name in your sleep.
: Do I actually do that?
scene yumiisheretoowtf14
: Mhm. Or at least I’m going to pretend you’re doing it in your sleep since the alternative is way too kinky for a girl as cute as you.
: I...normally wait until you’re not in the room to do that kind of stuff...
scene yumiisheretoowtf15
: Normally?
: I’m sure there...have been exceptions...
scene yumiisheretoowtf16
: Th-That’s not what we’re here to talk about, though! You’re supposed to be getting rest! That’s the whole reason we snuck away, isn’t it? So if you’re telling me you’re already feeling better-
: A few more minutes won’t hurt, will it? We’ve barely spent any time alone together lately.
scene yumiisheretoowtf17
: Is that your way of telling me you miss me?
: Better. It’s me telling you I love you.
: And how I can’t wait for our threesome.
scene yumiisheretoowtf18
: For our what?
: Wait...isn’t that what we were talking about earlier when-
: Oh...sorry. I didn’t realize you two were in here.
scene yumiisheretoowtf19
: Oh! H-Hey, Molly! You didn’t just...hear something super weird and random, right?
: No, I’m just...I don’t feel so great. Seeing Nithhala with that succubus is like...a dagger in my heart and I...I don’t want to deal with that right now...
: So I was hoping I could find reprieve in here for a moment or two, but...I don’t want to interrupt.
: You actually might have saved my life by arriving when you-
: Oh! I have an idea! Why not raid Ayane’s kitchen? Maya and I are kind of talking right now anyway.
: Nevermind, I guess. Ami clearly wants to kill me.
: I don’t know, Arborea...I’m not feeling very peckish right now.
: She has other stuff too, you know! Like beer and wine and all sorts of stuff you can use to numb the pain of your unrequited love!
scene yumiisheretoowtf20
: I...don’t know about that. The last time I got drunk at a Halloween party didn’t exactly...end well for me.
: Yeah, but you’ve got like a million extra people to watch over you this time. I’m sure you’ll be fine.
scene yumiisheretoowtf21
: Well, I...I suppose that does sound better than simply...watching the two of them or roaming Amamiyoria for the rest of eternity.
: Amamiyoria?
: The realm of the Amamiyas, duh.
: I...suppose I’ll be off then.
: If you want to just wait a few minutes-

: Bye, Molly! See you later! Don’t drink too much! Just enough to become fun. Or find a secret room and cope with your unrequited love in the more carnal and physical way! Just be sure to lock the door.
scene yumiisheretoowtf22
: Did you just...tell our friend to go masturbate her sadness away?
: Perhaps I’ll just do both? Who knows where this night will take me?
scene yumiisheretoowtf23
: Farewell, Mona. Farewell, Amber. Let the promise of ale whisk me away to...ahh, fuck it. Goodnight.
: So what’s this about a threesome?
scene yumiisheretoowtf24
: Do you seriously not remember that?! It was your idea! And you were really fucking into it!
: I think I’d remember suggesting a threesome to my best friend! This is a super weird way to confess that you’re into Sensei, Maya! What the heck?!
: I didn’t confess anything! You’re the one who figured it out when I got really upset about Niki moving in!
: With who?!
: You!
: Since when?! And why am I only hearing about this now?!
scene yumiisheretoowtf25
: Since when?...
: Maybe I...really am inside of a dream or a...movie right now. Because there’s no way I just...thought all that stuff up, did I?
: So you...really like Sensei then?
scene yumiisheretoowtf26
: Huh?...No, I...
: I mean yes, I...
: I don’t...I don’t really know...
scene yumiisheretoowtf27
: Sorry, I...I thought you knew.
: There was a...or at least I thought there was a whole thing earlier about...how that made you feel and...what we were going to do about it now that he was choosing Niki over us...
: I...didn’t even realize those two had gotten close again.
: This is...really bad news, isn’t it?
: Yeah...which is why we were going to do the threesome thing, I think. You said something about “dragging him back to us.”
: Maya, I’m sorry but this had to have been a dream or something. There’s no way I’d resort to such a ridiculous tactic to win Sensei over when I already know he’d choose me over her if I just ask.
: But that’s...that’s something I’d have to deal with on my own.
scene yumiisheretoowtf28

: B-Besides! It’s possible that, like...you’re totally just making this up right now! Hahahah! You are feeling pretty out of it, aren’t you? Like...you didn’t even know who you were dressed as a little while ago!
: Yeah...something’s clearly wrong with me. I just...have no idea what.
scene yumiisheretoowtf29
: Everything seems so...familiar but...also so fucking foreign at the same time that it’s kind of like I’m just floating through a sea of nothingness right now.
: And if you weren’t here to be my anchor, I...I feel like I might just drift away or...something corny like that...
: Well, uh...
: Um...how can I put this gently?
scene yumiisheretoowtf30
: I kinda...
: I kinda, like...need a minute to process all of this. So I think I’m gonna like...go for a walk or something.
: I...I really wasn’t trying to upset you if that’s what-
scene yumiisheretoowtf31
: No, no, no! It’s fine! I’m...used to finding out how my friends feel about him with...Ayane being so...forward about it every single day. I just...I need a minute, okay?
: But I...I really don’t want to be alone right now...
: Then, uhh...oh! Okay! How about I just...get a head start then...you count to ten and chase after me?
: Like...hide and seek?
: Y-Yeah! Just like hide and seek! And Ayane’s mansion is full of hiding places, so I can just...cram myself into one of those and figure out how to deal with all of this while you look for me.
: You really won’t stay and talk any longer?...
: Maya, I...
: Please...
scene black
: You can start counting once the door closes...
scene yumiisheretoowtf32
: Ten.
Paper doors and lanterns — arms that stretch for miles wide.
: Nine.
Ice cream cones and sunburn — not knowing when to laugh or cry.
: Eight.
Hide and seek and coloring — in books with pages white as snow.
: Seven...
Senseless, violent muttering — not knowing when you shouldn’t know.
: Six.
Watermelons left in light — a yellow patch to prove their worth.
: Five.
My mommy is a puzzle now — we dumped her pieces in the dirt.
: Four.
No one has it worse than me — and no one ever understands.
: Three...
An angel put a curse on me — now there’s Heaven in my hands.
scene yumiisheretoowtf33
: Two...
A box of better days — a room that’s filled with scary things.
scene black
: One.
A poem for you from me — a lonely girl with broken wings.
